name: Meta Fab, Inc.
old_description: Founded by Tim Varela more than 35 years ago, Meta Fab, Inc. continues today under the leadership of his son, Tony Varela. Meta Fab, Inc. continues to be a quick-turn, innovative, single-point-of-contact precision sheet metal and CNC machining facility. Our mission is simple: to give you confidence at every stage of your project – confidence in your timeline, your budget, and your finished product.
about:
Meta Fab, Inc. operates from Hillsboro, Oregon, in the region known as the Silicon Forest. The company was founded by Tim Varela more than 35 years ago and remains family-owned, with his son Tony Varela serving as president since 2022 after joining the business in 2009.

The shop specializes in precision sheet metal fabrication and CNC machining, offering a full suite of services that includes value-added assembly, powder coating and other finishing, hardware insertion, and design-for-manufacturability review. Meta Fab describes itself as a single-point-of-contact partner that takes projects from concept through completion, with quick-turn prototyping available in as little as 48 hours and a proprietary Burst Capacity model for scaling production. The company reports having fabricated more than a million parts annually.

Customers span aerospace systems, defense, medical devices, test and measurement, healthcare, computer technology, consumer electronics, communications, automotive, and aviation. The client base includes manufacturers, engineers, and OEMs; one named reference is GoFlight Technologies, which has relied on Meta Fab for over 15 years for metal parts and assembly.

Meta Fab emphasizes confidence in timeline, budget, and finished product. Its stated differentiators include a sense of urgency, financial responsibility, ethical practices, teamwork, and customer service, along with in-house capabilities that avoid outsourcing. The company highlights its ISO-certified quality system and long-term relationships built on transparency and reliability.
